## Constitution Compliance

- [ ] CHK001 Product remains within `Delivery Setup` and `Send Book`; no third primary screen is introduced
- [ ] CHK002 Default feedback is concise, derived from typed evidence, and reveals technical detail only when actionable
- [ ] CHK003 EPUB preparation runs locally through bounded safety, audit, deterministic cleanup/restoration, separate-copy writing, and revalidation
- [ ] CHK004 Original books and existing files remain immutable across success, failure, cancellation, and delivery uncertainty
- [ ] CHK005 Batch confirmation uses a stable snapshot; processing is sequential; outcomes and failures remain isolated per book
- [ ] CHK006 Archive and XML handling is bounded against traversal, ZIP bombs, duplicates, entities, links, remote references, memory, and time
- [ ] CHK007 Delivery is explicit and independent per book; failed and `delivery_unknown` items are never retried automatically
- [ ] CHK008 Credentials use protected macOS storage and remain redacted from interface, logs, reports, and repository files
- [ ] CHK009 SwiftUI views contain no archive, repair, restoration, filesystem, credential, or SMTP rules
- [ ] CHK010 Every automatic pipeline rule has a focused deterministic fixture-backed test
- [ ] CHK011 No Raycast, external engine, helper process, conversion, DRM removal, library, history, cloud, account, AI, or parallel product is introduced
- [ ] CHK012 Validation distinguishes static checks, compilation, automated tests, runtime inspection, signing, notarization, and release evidence
